verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is an equity-management SaaS, so a headless or API-driven automation mode is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only UI-driven workflows, manual bulk uploads, Excel exports and a vendor-managed Gusto sync. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt and no markdown docs, so nothing shows a public API, CLI or CI-runnable interface.
